meta.title: Jolom — read the map before you commit
meta.description: Jolom maps off-plan projects across the Emirates and Oman so investors can read a neighbourhood, a price, and a brief before they commit.

hero.title: Read the map before you commit.
hero.lede: Browse off-plan projects across the Emirates and Oman by neighbourhood—starting price and a short brief, in place. Each market keeps its own currency.
hero.currencyAe: Prices in UAE dirham · no conversion
hero.currencyOm: Prices in Omani rial · no conversion
hero.mapInvite: Touch a coloured district on the map — or follow the arrow into the full city.
hero.photoInvite: Open a neighbourhood card below, or step into the map from the photograph.

home.projectsTitle: Projects, with a neighbourhood and a starting price
home.projectsLede: Open a card to read that project. These figures belong to this sample desk, not today’s market.
home.pathTitle: From the map to the project
home.pathLede: The map finds the neighbourhood. The card shows the detail, before you call the desk.

steps.title: Choose the country
steps.body: The Emirates are shown in dirham, Oman in rial. The map opens on that country.

steps.title: Tap the neighbourhood
steps.body: Open the coloured shape. Starting price, project count, and the brief are there.

steps.title: Read the project
steps.body: Payment plan, bedrooms, plot size, and a way to reach the desk.

scores.title: Five readings, one number.
scores.lede: Each project is scored on site, water, energy, air, and light. The number is a reading of the brief, not a promise of return.

mapTeaser.title: Neighbourhoods you can colour, price, and describe.
mapTeaser.lede: Tap a district in the Emirates or Oman. The panel carries a photograph, the price, the projects, and a way to draw your own boundary.

projects.title: Projects an investor can actually read.

areas.title: Neighbourhoods across the Emirates and Oman

journal.title: Read these three notes before you pay

items.title: The handover year is not a fixed date
items.excerpt: The year on the card is the developer’s aim. Ask what is already built, and what is still on paper.

items.title: Colour does not tell the whole story
items.excerpt: The desk chooses the colour so neighbourhoods stay apart. Open the card and read the brief.

items.title: Ask the agent these things
items.excerpt: Service charge, who holds the escrow, what the yield assumes, and which homes are still unsold.

pocket.title: The same map, on a phone
pocket.lede: Stand in the neighbourhood, open the project card on your phone, and read it there. You do not need a desk.

footer.tagline: A guiding light for off-plan investment in the Emirates and Oman.
footer.rights: Sample book for investors and agents. Figures are illustrative.
footer.note: Neighbourhood shapes on the map are simplified drawings on a public basemap, for the Emirates and Oman. They are not official cadastral boundaries.

detail.yieldNote: Illustrative yearly yield from the sample book, not a forecast.

dubai-hills.name: Dubai Hills
dubai-hills.body: A wide residential park with a golf course at its middle. Villas sit on quiet streets; apartments line the park edge. Investors come for family demand and a long hold.

business-bay.name: Business Bay
business-bay.body: Towers along the canal, a short walk from Downtown. The book here is mostly apartments, traded by people who want a rental from day one of handover.

jvc.name: Jumeirah Village Circle
jvc.body: A ring of low towers and townhouses around a circle of parks. Entry prices sit lower than the coast, which is why first-time investors start here.

creek-harbour.name: Dubai Creek Harbour
creek-harbour.body: Water on one side, a new skyline on the other. The projects are still young, so the brief matters more than a finished street.

palm-jumeirah.name: Palm Jumeirah
palm-jumeirah.body: The fronds and the trunk. Villas face the sea; apartments face the trunk road. Prices jump with the view, not with the floor plan.

dubai-marina.name: Dubai Marina
dubai-marina.body: A finished canal city. Most of the book is resale, and the off-plan that remains is tucked into the last plots.

dubai-south.name: Dubai South
dubai-south.body: Near the airport and the exhibition city. Prices are the gentlest in this book, and the wait for a street life is the longest.

dubai-land.name: Dubai Land
dubai-land.body: A spread of villa communities east of the city. The pitch is space, a garden, and a handover that still has years on it.

safa-court.name: Safa Court
safa-court.body: Courtyard villas on the park side of Dubai Hills. The brief leans on shade, a short walk to the lake, and a family plan rather than a quick flip.

creek-atelier.name: Creek Atelier
creek-atelier.body: A slim tower on the creek with deeper balconies than the neighbouring plots. The score is the highest in this book because the site, water, and air readings all sit high.

palm-shade.name: Palm Shade
palm-shade.body: Garden villas on an inner frond. Light is the strength. Water and energy readings are only fair, which keeps the score below the creek projects.

quarter-nine.name: Quarter Nine
quarter-nine.body: Canal apartments in Business Bay, aimed at a rental from handover. The illustrative yield is the second highest in the book.

walk-residences.name: Walk Residences
walk-residences.body: Mid-rise homes on the JVC ring, priced for a first allocation. The plan is a walkable courtyard, not a skyline.

southlight.name: Southlight House
southlight.body: Compact apartments beside the exhibition grounds. The yield reading is the strongest in the book, and the score is the most cautious.

landline-villas.name: Landline Villas
landline-villas.body: A villa row in Dubai Land with wider plots than the coastal stock. Water and air are the readings that carry it.

marina-loom.name: Marina Loom
marina-loom.body: One of the last off-plan plots on the marina edge. Handover is the nearest in the book, which is the point of the brief.

nahla.name: Nahla
nahla.body: A Dubai studio that builds family houses and mid-rise courtyards. In this book they hold Safa Court and Walk Residences.

lumen.name: Lumen Harbour
lumen.body: Waterfront apartments. Creek Atelier and Southlight House are their two entries here, at opposite ends of the price book.

qasr.name: Qasr Properties
qasr.body: Villas, slowly. Palm Shade and Landline Villas are the two they have placed with Jolom.

safa-co.name: Safa & Co
safa-co.body: Canal and marina apartments for investors who want a rental brief. Quarter Nine and Marina Loom are theirs.

admin.title: Atlas desk
admin.lede: This desk publishes the public atlas: Emirates and Oman cities, neighbourhood boundaries, projects, payment schedules, contact numbers, and search suggestions.

admin.error: That atlas could not be saved.
admin.resetConfirm: Replace the saved atlas with the sample book? This cannot be undone from here.
admin.siteResetConfirm: Replace the current brand, contact, landing, and SEO fields with the sample site content?
admin.name: Name
admin.deleteConfirm: This record will be removed from the published atlas.
admin.blocked: Remove the records that still point here first.
admin.duplicate: That id is already in use.
admin.idInvalid: Id must use Latin letters, numbers, or hyphens (e.g. emaar).
admin.formInvalid: Not saved — fix the highlighted fields.
admin.needName: Enter at least the English name.
admin.needCity: Choose a city for this area.
admin.needTarget: Choose a target for this suggestion.
admin.needPoint: Place the project pin on the map.
admin.needBrandName: Enter the brand name in at least one language.
admin.needPassword: Password must be at least 8 characters.
admin.makeSlugHint: Builds a unique id from the English name (or FA/AR if Latin characters remain). Adds a numeric suffix if taken.
admin.needRing: Draw at least three corners and close the area.
admin.needArea: Choose a neighbourhood for this project.
admin.needDeveloper: Choose a developer for this project.
admin.paymentTotalWarn: Payment steps should add up to about 100%.
admin.areaGuideHint: Coloured dashed outline = neighbourhood (guide only). Green numbered shape = this project’s footprint.
admin.mapHint: Place corners on the map, close the boundary, then adjust with the handles. Use Freehand or Circle when a rough outline is faster.
admin.deskNavHint: Pick a desk, then a section.
admin.deskEmptyHint: No sections here — manage accounts in the main panel.
admin.loginLede: Sign in with your desk username and password.
admin.denied: That username or password is not right for this desk.
admin.missingPassword: No desk users are set up yet. Add ADMIN_PASSWORD to .env.local and restart once.
admin.usersLede: Staff accounts for the atlas and site desks. Passwords are stored hashed.
admin.deleteUserConfirm: They will no longer be able to sign in to the desk.
admin.usernameInvalid: Username needs at least two letters or numbers.
admin.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete the account you are signed in with.
admin.cannotDeleteLast: Keep at least one desk user.
admin.siteLede: Brand, contact details, landing copy, and SEO for the public site.
admin.uploadError: Upload failed. Use PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, or GIF under 2 MB.
admin.brandPreviewHint: Preview of the public header mark. An empty logo uses the default Jolom mark.
admin.featuredDevelopersHint: Up to four developers featured on the home page, in display order.
admin.unitsHint: Bedroom bands on the project card: beds, from-price, and size range (sqft).
admin.unitBedsHint: Bedroom count for this band (studio, 1, 2, 3, or 4).
admin.unitPriceFromHint: From-price for this bedroom band in the market currency (AED or OMR).
admin.unitSizeMinHint: Minimum size for this band, square feet.
admin.unitSizeMaxHint: Maximum size for this band, square feet.
admin.paymentHint: Payment schedule on the project card. Steps should total about 100%, with labels in EN, AR, and FA.
admin.paymentPercentHint: Percentage due at this step (0–100). Combined steps should total about 100%.
admin.paymentLabelHint: Short label on the public card (e.g. On booking, During construction, On handover).
admin.modeCornerHint: Click to place corners. Close by clicking the first (gold) handle or Close shape. Drag handles to fine-tune.
admin.modeSmoothHint: Legacy smooth-on-close mode. Prefer Points plus Soften after the boundary is set.
admin.modeRoundHint: Click the centre, then the edge to place a circular boundary.
admin.modeHandHint: Drag on the map to draw. Release to replace the current boundary.
admin.closeShapeHint: Closes the open outline into a neighbourhood or project boundary on the public map.
admin.reopenShapeHint: Reopens a closed boundary so you can append corners by clicking the map again.
admin.clickToPlaceHint: Required. Click the map to set the pin shown on the public map. Draw the neighbourhood boundary under Areas, not here.
admin.clickToDrawHint: Optional. The project’s own footprint (plot/buildings). It is not the neighbourhood — that appears as the dashed guide.
admin.aboutHint: Listing copy for this record, one version per language.
admin.aboutHintDetail: Shown on the public card and detail page: location, product type, and key commercial facts.
admin.softenHint: Applies a light rounding pass to the current boundary geometry.
admin.idHint: Permanent id used in URLs. Set when creating the record; do not change later.
admin.deliveredHint: Homes already handed over by this developer (shown on the public developer card).
admin.imageHint: Cover image for the public card. Use a full https URL or an /uploads/… path.
admin.countryHint: Market for this city. Emirates listings use AED; Oman listings use OMR.
admin.lngHint: Map centre longitude (WGS84). Click the map to set it.
admin.latHint: Map centre latitude (WGS84). Click the map to set it.
admin.zoomHint: Default map zoom when this city opens (typically 10–14).
admin.cityHint: City that owns this neighbourhood on the public map.
admin.colorHint: Fill colour for this neighbourhood polygon on the map.
admin.developerHint: Developer linked to this project on the public site.
admin.kindHint: Product type shown on the project card: apartment, villa, or townhouse.
admin.handoverHint: Target handover shown on the card (year or quarter, e.g. 2028 or Q4 2027).
admin.unitCountHint: Total units shown on the card (display figure, not live stock).
admin.currencyHint: Price currency for this project. May differ from the country default (e.g. USD listings in the Emirates).
admin.projectFootprintHint: Click the map to add corners for this project’s plot. Drag numbers to adjust; green + adds a point on a long side.
admin.startPriceHint: Lowest published starting price in the selected currency.
admin.sizeMinHint: Smallest published unit size in square feet.
admin.sizeMaxHint: Largest published unit size in square feet.
admin.whatsappHint: WhatsApp number with country code, digits only (e.g. 9715…).
admin.phoneHint: Public phone number on the project card.
admin.targetHint: Destination opened by this search suggestion: city, neighbourhood, or project.
admin.orderHint: Sort weight in search suggestions. Lower numbers appear first.
admin.nameEnHint: English name on the public site.
admin.nameArHint: Arabic name on the public site.
admin.nameFaHint: Persian name on the public site.
admin.aboutEnHint: English listing copy for cards and detail pages.
admin.aboutArHint: Arabic listing copy for cards and detail pages.
admin.aboutFaHint: Persian listing copy for cards and detail pages.
admin.brandNameHint: Brand name in the public header and footer for each language.
admin.brandLogoHelp: Logo URL or uploaded file. Leave empty to keep the default mark.
admin.sitePhoneHint: Primary phone number in the public footer.
admin.siteWhatsappHint: WhatsApp number for the footer contact action, digits only.
admin.siteEmailHint: Public email address in the footer.
admin.socialHint: Full profile URL. Leave blank to hide the icon.
admin.heroTitleHint: Primary headline on the home page hero.
admin.heroLedeHint: Supporting line under the home page hero title.
admin.landingCopyHint: Public copy for this home page section.
admin.seoSiteNameHint: Short site name for browser tabs and SEO templates.
admin.seoDefaultTitleHint: Default document title when a page has no custom SEO title.
admin.seoDefaultDescriptionHint: Default meta description when a page has no custom SEO description.
admin.displayNameHint: Name shown inside the desk after sign-in.
admin.passwordHintField: Minimum 8 characters. Use a unique password per user.
admin.addUserHint: Creates a desk account for one staff member.
admin.usersListHint: Desk accounts with access to the atlas and site desks.
admin.listHint: Search and open a row to edit. Nothing is published until you press Save.
admin.mapHintSimple: Numbered = move corner. Green + = add / pull a side. Modes: Points, Freehand, Circle.
admin.mapHintDetail: Points: click corners, then close by clicking the gold first handle, clicking near it, or Close shape. Freehand: drag on the map (replaces the current outline). Circle: centre then radius. After closing, edit with handles or Reopen to add corners by click.
admin.handReadyHint: Drag on the map to draw. Release to replace the current boundary.
admin.circleCenterHint: Click the map to set the circle centre.
admin.circleRadiusHint: Click again to set the radius.
admin.closedEditHint: Boundary is closed — drag handles to edit, or Reopen / Freehand / Circle to redraw.
admin.closeReadyHint: Click the gold first handle (or Close shape) to join the first and last points.
admin.undoHint: Steps back one change to the whole boundary — moving a vertex, closing the shape, clearing, and so on. Pair with Redo to step forward again.
admin.redoHint: Re-applies the change you just undid with Undo.
admin.undoPointHint: Removes only the last corner you placed in Points mode; the rest of the outline stays. Use this while drawing point-by-point — it is not full Undo.
admin.coachPointPlaceStep: Click the map to place the public pin. The coloured dashed outline is the neighbourhood — do not redraw it here.
admin.projectPlaceHint: Correct flow: pick the neighbourhood (dashed guide appears), then set the project pin. Use footprint mode only if you need a separate plot outline.
admin.coachHandStep: Press on the map, drag the outline, then release. The new boundary replaces the old one.
admin.coachCircleCenterStep: Click the map to place the centre.
admin.coachCircleRadiusStep: Move the pointer to size the circle, then click to confirm.
admin.coachPointsDrawStep: Click to drop corners. Green + appears on long sides only — click it to add a point.
admin.coachPointsClosedStep: Drag numbered handles to move corners. Click a green + on a long side to add a point, then drag that new number.
